about: The generated symbols of the NetTest specification (section 'Time, sequence and symbols'), those of QD NetTest. For each total: draws is the number of symbols drawn, duplicates included, until total distinct ones appear; samples give the symbol at a 0-based index in the order of first appearance; fnv1a64 is the 64-bit FNV-1a hash (offset basis 0xCBF29CE484222325, prime 0x100000001B3) of the ASCII bytes of the symbols in that order, each followed by a line feed. The symbols of a smaller total are the first symbols of a larger one.
